[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#00ff00]A demon companion that replaces the Parrot Companion and Parrot Egg design.[/color][color=#D4D4D8] It's kind of a mix between a Tiefling, Harpy and Imp so I just decided calling it a demon would be kinda accurate. I actually didn't plan on making a demon, I planned on making another fairy, but once I started thinking of a harpy because of the wings this demon's fate was sealed.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]The demon is meant to be masculine since I already have feminine fairies. This is why there's no top on the chest.[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Only 1 design to replace the Parrot [/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Only 1 design to replace the Parrot Egg[/color][/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Spawn in Parrot Egg[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]. Once installed, press I on keyboard and type in [b]Parrot Egg [/b]in the Search to add to your inventory[/*]
[*]Equip to your special item slot. It's found next to your hat slot in the inventory menu.[/*]
[/list][left][img]https://i.postimg.cc/5N3Nq8ZD/Screenshot-2026-08-11-164514.png[/img][/left]
[list]
[*]Must have completed mastery of ALL 5 skills to unlock the slot and use the parrot egg. You MUST go to the special cave near the sewer and claim mastery rewards before the item slot is available to you. You can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4]CJB Cheats[/url] to do this if you want the parrot egg in early game.[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Permission To:[/size][/b]
[list]

[*][color=#00ff00]Remake assets[/color] (stuff like using my sprites as a base for your own fairies or changing how they look). Please credit me for making the original mod if you upload it online. [/*]
[*][color=#00ff00]Use Donation Points[/color] when posting mods that use my assets.  Please credit me for making the original mod if you upload it online. [/*]
[*][color=#00ff00]Maintain this mod with updates if I ever abandon it.[/color] While I'm alive, I don't plan to abandon this mod, but anything can happen. My feelings can change or I end up dying. I am aware of authors who abandon their work for whatever reason and players wanting to still enjoy the mod, so I think it's only right to allow players to still have access to the mod in the future. [color=#00ff00]Please check when I was last active before taking over this mod [/color](It shows this on my Profile) since I may still be active but not prioritizing this mod. I'd appreciate it if you would leave a message on the mod page if you see that I am still active but the mod needs updating. [/*]
[/list]
